name: Banh bot loc
summary: Bánh bột lọc, also called bánh lọc, is a small dumpling of cassava flour filled with shrimp and pork, steamed plain or in a banana leaf. It is one of the central coast’s small steamed cakes.
origin: The central coast, with bánh bèo and bánh nậm.
howToEat: Order it with the other small steamed cakes.
In Dong Hoi the cake is hot cassava flour, filled with shrimp and pork, plain or in a banana leaf, and also fried, sometimes with mushroom and sour bamboo shoot, or wood-ear and mung bean.
where: In Da Nang, ordinary restaurants group bánh lọc with bánh bèo, bánh nậm, and bánh xèo, and it is on Con Market’s outdoor counters.
In Dong Hoi the cake is on Lê Thành Đồng and Đồng Hải. Chợ Đồng Hới also splits a hot loaf and fills it with shrimp cakes and mung-bean cakes, plus a hot sauce.
seoTitle: Banh bot loc — shrimp and pork dumplings
seoDescription: Bánh bột lọc is a cassava-flour dumpling with shrimp and pork. Where to eat it in Da Nang and Dong Hoi.
